g.text: Fixed read service: 16 vCPUs · 64 GiB | Same dataset | Warm data cache | Result cache off
12 repetitions per query and limit. Throughput: total bytes / total server time. Latency: median. Shading: IQR.
Queries run sequentially in shuffled order. CPU parallelism is controlled with max_threads on the fixed service.
